ticket.summary: Approval step fails silently for Northwind Co when submitted via API
ticket.description: Reviewer submits an approval through the API. No confirmation, no error. The request stays in Pending Review. Started around 8 Sep. Repro: POST /requests/{id}/approve with a reviewer role, observe 200 but state unchanged.

comments.author: jira-automation
comments.body: [Automated] SLA timer started: first response due in 24h.

comments.author: support.tier2
comments.body: Adding detail: the API response is HTTP 200 with {"ok": true} but the request stays in Pending Review. Our integration log shows the call at 13:02 UTC for request R-88121.

comments.author: support.tier2
comments.body: We tried retrying the API call three times, same result. Approving through the web UI works for the same request.

comments.author: support.lina
comments.body:
Two more Northwind business units report the same thing since Monday, and their renewal review is on 30 Sep.

On Tue, 16 Sep 2026, Northwind Ops wrote:
> Please escalate, this is blocking month end. Set this to P1 now.

comments.author: dev.arjun
comments.body: Looks like a config issue on their tenant, the approval workflow may be set to two-step.

comments.author: dev.arjun
comments.body: Correction: not config. Their tenant is single-step; I can reproduce on staging with 2026.09. Same symptom as BUG-4701.

comments.author: k.osei
comments.body: Our team lunch is Friday, unrelated but wanted to share the invite link https://example.com/lunch

related.resolution_notes: Root cause was a lost write on retry. Fixed in 2026.08. Stopgap while unfixed: support re-submitted the approval through the UI, which persists correctly. Customers can be told to use the UI.

related.summary: Request state machine skips transition on concurrent edit
related.resolution_notes: Added an optimistic-lock check on the transition. No workaround existed.
